description: Hetzner Cloud Jenkins plugin (v103.percona.13+): circuit breakers, provisioning latency, rate-limit headroom, API health, capacity vs cap, anomaly counters, and correlated SLF4J logs from /hetzner-prometheus and Loki. v2 (2026-05-12) fixes the idle-fleet success-rate gauge, the Loki level regex, the pending-vs-reap axis collision, the empty-stat label loss on anomaly counters, and adds API and capacity visibility. v3 (2026-05-18) adds panel 50 'Provisioning outcomes by class' so bootstrap_other / rate_limited / dc_unavailable are visible alongside the success-rate gauge. v4 (2026-05-20) adds an Arch variable (All / amd64 / arm64) wired through the template-labelled panels, a per-arch summary row of six stat panels at the top, and a server_type breakdown on the per-location worker chart. Arch split uses the regex on 'template' label (cpx* -> x64, cax* -> aarch64) since the cloud-only gauges (running_servers, instance_cap) cannot be split without a plugin change.

panels.title: Provisions/min (amd64)
panels.description: Successful AMD64 provisions per minute, 5-minute sliding window. Filters by template name containing 'x64' (cpx* server types).

panels.title: Provisions/min (arm64)
panels.description: Successful ARM64 provisions per minute, 5-minute sliding window. Filters by template name containing 'aarch64' (cax* server types).

panels.title: Success rate (amd64)
panels.description: AMD64 provisioning success rate, 5-minute window. Empty (no activity) renders as 0 (the 'noValue' default); red below 90%, yellow 90-95%, green at or above 95%.

panels.title: Success rate (arm64)
panels.description: ARM64 provisioning success rate, 5-minute window. Same colouring as the amd64 panel.

panels.title: Stuck builds (amd64)
panels.description: AMD64 builds active for more than 24 hours. Non-zero means a build is hung on an amd64 worker.

panels.title: Stuck builds (arm64)
panels.description: ARM64 builds active for more than 24 hours.

panels.title: Stuck builds per master (24h+ threshold)
panels.description: Count of builds that crossed the 24h hang threshold in the last 24 hours. Emitted by HungBuildDetector PeriodicWork (v103.percona.17+). Healthy fleet is all zeros. Increments fire ONCE per build crossing the threshold, deduped via in-plugin cache.

panels.title: Oldest building build per master (age in seconds)
panels.description: For each master, the elapsed age of the longest-running building build right now. Emitted by HungBuildDetector PeriodicWork (v103.percona.17+). Green up to 12h, yellow up to 24h, red above. Cross-reference with `jenkins admin -i <master> incidents` for triage.

panels.title: Active workers per master
panels.description: Live count of Hetzner worker nodes currently provisioned per Jenkins master. Bar length is proportional to count; color shifts to yellow above 70% of master cap, red above 90%. Sorted descending by count.

panels.title: Fleet capacity roll-up
panels.description: One row per master with running/pending/cap/utilization side by side. Shows where the fleet has provisioning headroom and where it is at the ceiling. Masters that have never provisioned Hetzner workers (e.g. pmm.cd) will show empty values for running and pending.

panels.title: Worker templates per location
panels.description: How many configured Hetzner worker templates the fleet has per Hetzner datacenter (nbg1, fsn1, hel1, ash, hil, sin). Compare with the DC circuit breaker panel to spot DCs that are configured but consistently failing.

panels.title: Running workers per master over time
panels.description: Hetzner worker node count per master over the dashboard time range. Each line is a master; the y-value is the live count of running servers at that instant. Lines rise when workers spawn, fall when reaped. v103.percona.16+ refreshes the gauge every minute regardless of provisioning activity; pre-.16 masters can show stale flat lines (see panel 200 status). Pairs with panel 200 (instant view) and panel 201 (per-master capacity table).

panels.title: DC circuit breaker state
panels.description: 0 = CLOSED (healthy), 1 = HALF_OPEN (probing), 2 = OPEN (skipping). One series per master/location.

panels.title: Provisioning success rate (5m)
panels.description: Successful provisions / total provision attempts, last 5 minutes. Shows 'no attempts' (not red) when the fleet is idle.

panels.title: Provisioning outcomes by class (5m)
panels.description: Per-class breakdown of hetzner_provision_attempts_total over the last 5 minutes. Reads alongside the success-rate gauge: the gauge says 'how many fail', this panel says 'why'. Key classes when triaging: bootstrap_other (Hetzner control-plane stall, see status.hetzner.com), bootstrap_io (master to agent SSH/network), rate_limited / unclassified_throttle (per-token API throttle), dc_unavailable / failover_incompatible (DC stockout or template mismatch), precheck_failure / config_error (template config error before any API call), cap_reached_under_lock (instance cap), failure (uncategorized; should stay near zero).

panels.title: Provision latency p95 by template (5m)
panels.description: 95th percentile of hetzner_provision_duration_seconds_bucket, grouped by template label.

panels.title: API rate-limit headroom
panels.description: One line per Jenkins master = one independent Hetzner API token bucket (3600 req/hr per token, rolling 1h window). Each master has its own token, so red on one line does NOT affect the others. Green >=500 (healthy). Yellow 200-500 (provision storm forming, ~3-9 min headroom). Red <200 (near exhaustion; at 0 the plugin self-suppresses provisions for 60s on that master). Every API call counts, including rejected resource_unavailable create_server (e.g. CAX stockout).

panels.title: Pending provisions vs orphan reap rate
panels.description: In-flight provisions (left axis, count) overlaid with orphan-server reap rate (right axis, events/sec). A growing gap suggests provision attempts are leaking.

panels.title: Anomaly counters (last 1h)
panels.description: Increase over the last hour. CRW underflow + Uncaught are structural-fault canaries: any non-zero value indicates a code-level bug. Ghost nodes + DC failovers are routine events; small numbers are normal. Empty (no series) renders as 0.

panels.title: Hetzner-plugin log stream
panels.description: SLF4J output from the patched plugin (HetznerCloud, NodeCallable, OrphanedNodesCleaner, DcCircuitBreaker, HetznerApiClient, RateLimitInterceptor, RetryInterceptor, TemplateErrorTracker). For ps3-k8s the stream is live today; for the EC2 masters it appears once the master-side Alloy systemd unit ships (Phase 2.5c).

panels.title: Log rate by level (5m)
panels.description: Message rate by JUL level. Jenkins logs in single-line tab-delimited format: `<date>+<tz> [id=N]\t<LEVEL>\t<class>#<method>: <msg>`. Header lines abbreviate the package to `c.d.j.p.hetzner.X`; stack traces keep the full FQCN. Filter matches both forms.

panels.title: API request rate by status class
panels.description: Hetzner API request rate split by HTTP status class (2xx/4xx/5xx/network). Leading indicator before the rate-limit gauge moves during a Hetzner-side incident.

panels.title: API latency p95 / p99 by method
panels.description: Per-method Hetzner API latency. Tells you whether boot-time slowness is Hetzner-side (this panel) vs launcher-side (panel 3 'provision latency') vs token-throttle (panel 4 'rate-limit headroom').

panels.title: Provision skipped + leaked
panels.description: Why provisions are NOT happening (skipped by reason) and whether the plugin had to declare a server leaked (provisioned but never reached the launcher). Answers 'builds are queueing but nothing spawns'.

panels.title: Capacity utilization per master (%)
panels.description: Per-master Hetzner capacity utilization = running workers / configured cap, as a percentage. One line per master. Green <70%, yellow 70-90%, red >=90% (at the ceiling; new provision requests will be rejected). Pairs with panel 201 (instant snapshot table) and panel 5 (pending vs orphan reap for leak detection). Raw running counts over time live in panel 203.

panels.title: Plugin version drift
panels.description: Counts masters by reported in-memory Hetzner plugin version. Healthy fleet shows ONE version. Multiple values means classloader/runtime drift even if the installed .jpi files are byte-identical (a busy master needs JVM restart).

panels.title: Plugin version per master
panels.description: Live Hetzner plugin version reported by each master via hetzner_plugin_info. Use this to confirm a fleet rollout has activated (busy masters retain the prior in-memory version until JVM restart). Cross-check with the Drift stat panel above for fleet-wide skew.

list.name: arch
list.label: Arch
list.description: Filter panels by worker architecture. Regex-valued: All=.*, amd64=.*x64.*, arm64=.*aarch64.* (matches the Hetzner template-name convention where every Jenkins template name embeds an arch token).

title: Hetzner Cloud Plugin
